book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Sɔbu sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di
Bɑ Yesu mɑrɑwɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ Yudeɑn temɔ, sinɑ boko Herodun wɑɑti. Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ, kperin sɑriɑ yɛ̃robu ɡɑbu bɑ nɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di,
mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ Yuubɑn sunɔ wi bɑ mɑrɑ tɛ̃ u wɑ̃ɑ. Domi sɑ win kperɑ wɑ yɑ kurɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerɔ, yerɑ sɑ nɑ su nùn sɑ̃.
Ye sinɑ boko Herodu u ɡɑri yi nuɑ, win bwɛ̃rɑ kun kpunɛ, kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibun tii kpuro.
U yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kpuro mɛnnɑ kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ bɑ koo wi Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ
mɑ.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Bɛtelehɛmuɔrɑ Yudeɑn tem sɔɔ, domi Gusunɔn sɔmɔ u yoruɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: n ǹ mɔ wunɑ ɑ piiburu bo Yudeɑn wuu bɑkɑsu sɔɔ.
Domi wunɛn min diyɑ sunɔ u koo yɑri
wi u koo nɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kpɑrɑ.”

content: Yerɑ Herodu u kperin sɑriɑ yɛ̃ro be sokusiɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ mɑ u bu bikiɑ sɑɑ ye kperɑ ye, yɑ kurɑ mɑm mɑm.
Mɑ u derɑ bɑ dɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ. U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu doo bu bii win ɡɑri bikiɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Bɑ̀ n nùn wɑ bu ɡɔsirɑmɑ bu nùn sɔ̃, kpɑ win tii u mɑɑ dɑ u nùn sɑ̃.
Ye bɑ win ɡɑri yi nuɑ bɑ kpɑ, yerɑ bɑ swɑɑ wɔri. Wee, kperɑ ye bɑ rɑɑ wɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerɔ, yɑ kpɑm bu swɑɑ ɡbiiye sere yɑm mi bii wi, u wɑ̃ɑ, mɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ yɑm min wɔllɔ.
Ye bɑ kperɑ ye wɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ dorɑ n bɑndɑ.
Ye bɑ duɑ diru mi, bɑ bii wi wɑ kɑ win mɛro Mɑɑri. Yerɑ bɑ yiirɑ bɑ nùn sɑ̃wɑ. Mɑ bɑ ben bɔɔnu kusiɑ, bɑ wurɑ wunɑ bɑ nùn kɑ̃, kɑ turɑre bwesenu yiru.
Mɑ Gusunɔ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ dosu sɔɔ u nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ wure Herodun mi. Mɑ bɑ sĩɑ ben wuuɔ kɑ swɑɑ tukɑ.
Bɑ kɑ Yesu kpikiru dɑ Eɡibitiɔ

Ye kperin sɑriɑ yɛ̃ro be, bɑ biru kisi bɑ doonɑ, mɑ Yinnin ɡɔrɑdo u Yosɛfu kure dosu sɔɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ bii wi kɑ win mɛro suɑ kpɑ ɑ kɑ bu kpikiru su Eɡibiti ɡiɑ, ɑ sinɑ mi sere dɔmɑ te kon mɑɑ nun sɔ̃ ɑ sĩimɑ, domi Herodu u koo bii wi kɑsu u ɡo.
Mɑ Yosɛfu u seewɑ wɔ̃kuru u bii wi kɑ win mɛro suɑ mɑ u doonɑ Eɡibiti ɡiɑ.
U sinɑ mi sere Herodu u kɑ ɡu. Yeni yɑ koorɑ kpɑ Yinnin ɡɑri yi u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win sɔmɔn nɔɔ sɔɔn di yi kɑ koorɑ ye u nɛɛ, “Eɡibitin diyɑ nɑ nɛn bii sokumɑ.”
Bɑ bii tɔn durɔ piiminu ɡo

Ye Herodu u wɑ mɑ sɔɔ be bɑ nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di bɑ nùn yɑɑkoru kuɑ, u mɔru bɛsirɑ. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ bii tɔn durɔbu kpuro ɡo be bɑ ǹ wɔ̃ɔ yiru kere Bɛtelehɛmuɔ kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kpuro. Domi u yen sɑnɑm dooru kuɑ mìn di sɔɔ be, bɑ nɛɛ bɑ kperɑ ye wɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ ye Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Yeremi u ɡeruɑ, yɑ koorɑ, ye u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yɛ̃ro u sumɔ u weeweenu mɔ̀.
Ase Rɑsɛliwɑ u sumɔ win bibun sɔ̃.
Mɑ u yinɑ bu nùn suuru kɑnɑ
domi bii be kpurowɑ bɑ ɡu.”

content: Bɑ kɑ Yesu wurɑmɑ
Eɡibitin di
Herodu u ɡu. Win ɡɔɔn biru Yinnin ɡɔrɑdo u Yosɛfu kure dosu sɔɔ Eɡibitiɔ.
U nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ bii wi kɑ win mɛro suɑ kpɑ i wurɑ Isirelin temɔ, domi be bɑ kĩ bu bii wi ɡo, bɑ ɡu.
Mɑ Yosɛfu seewɑ u bii wi kɑ win mɛro suɑ bɑ kpɑm wurɑ Isirelin temɔ.
Adɑmɑ ye u nuɑ mɑ Aɑkelusi u bɑndu di Yudeɑn temɔ win bɑɑ Herodun ɑyerɔ, u bɛrum kuɑ u kɑ sinɑ mi. Mɑ u doonɑ Gɑlilen temɔ, nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ dosu sɔɔ.
Mɑ u dɑ u sinɑ wuu ɡe bɑ sokumɔ Nɑsɑrɛtiɔ, kpɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbun ɡɑri yi kɑ koorɑ yi yi nɛɛ, “Bɑ koo nùn sokuwɑ Nɑsɑrɛtiɡii.”
